in_marathi.name: Kinari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of love and beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kinari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Kinari means 'the one who is adorned with love and beauty'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kinara', which means 'border' or 'edge'. In Hindu mythology, Kinari is a name for the goddess of love and beauty, Saraswati. She is often depicted holding a veena, an instrument symbolizing music and knowledge. Kinari is a name that embodies grace, elegance, and the power of love.
